//==
// # IProcedural rig control
//
// The structures that adjust a skeleton's pose rather than store it:
// inverse-kinematics chains and their goals, aim and twist constraints,
// per-bone masking of an animation layer, and the bone mapping that retargets
// a clip from one skeleton onto another. Bone references index the owning
// skeleton's bone array; -1 is the "no bone" sentinel throughout.

// The algorithm an inverse-kinematics chain is solved with: an analytic
// two-segment solve, cyclic coordinate descent, or forward-and-backward
// reaching.
type IkSolver = TwoBone | Ccd | Fabrik;
